boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The box office is open on event days only, beginning 2 hours prior to door time.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Visa, Mastercard, Discover, American Express. This is a cashless venue.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Tickets may be picked up beginning 2 hours prior to showtime at the Box Office. Will call tickets only available for that day's event. Customer must have the actual credit card used to place the order, a picture ID, and the order confirmation number.

venues.parkingDetail: Our friends at Venture Richmond (https://venturerichmond.com/) have rounded up the top recommendations for parking and transportation options around Downtown Richmond. Keep in mind: Richmond offers free parking in many areas Downtown on nights and weekends. GRTC Pulse: The zero-fare Pulse Bus Rapid Transit line is a convenient option, with the nearest stop about a 13-minute walk away. The Pulse runs: Every 10 minutes on weekdays until 7:00 PM; Every 15 minutes in the evening and on weekends; Every 30 minutes late night (11:30 PM - 1:00 AM). Pulse buses stop only at platform-level stations and use smart signal technology to stay on schedule. Bike Rack Locations: Bringing your bike? Racks are located: Along Tredegar Street near 5th Street; Where the bridge meets Tredegar and Brown's Island; At the Main Entrance on 5th Street. Scooters: Zip over on a rental scooter! Richmond offers Bird, Lime, and Spin scooters throughout the city. Just download the app for your preferred service to find a nearby ride. For more information on parking please visit - https://www.allianzamphitheater.com/
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating is available at all points of purchase. For more details please visit: https://www.allianzamphitheater.com/accessibility

generalInfo.childRule: Our venue is all ages. Children under the age of 2 do not require a ticket. We understand that little ones often come with diaper bags, which are ok, but they'll just be subject to a security screening. Children without a ticket must sit on a caregiver's lap if they are located in the seats.
